standard: PCAF (2025). Global GHG Accounting and Reporting Standard Part A: Financed Emissions. Third Edition.
detail: Annex Table 10.1-1, p.191 — data needs and equations per option
note: Options 1 and 2 are preferred over Option 3. An institution may use Option 1 or 2 for some companies and Option 3 for others; the mix shall be reflected in the outstanding-weighted score (p.45). Option 2a is applicable to scope 1 and 2 only (footnote 53). Options 3b and 3c produce no attribution factor (footnote 41).
scale: 1 is the highest data quality, 5 the lowest. A score is a category, never a mark out of five.

options.when: Outstanding amount in the company and EVIC or total debt and equity are known. Verified emissions of the company are available.
Outstanding amount in the company and EVIC or total debt and equity are known. Unverified emissions calculated by the company are available.

Outstanding amount in the company and EVIC or total debt and equity are known. Reported company emissions are not known. Emissions are calculated using primary physical activity data of the company's energy consumption and emission factors specific to that primary data. Relevant process emissions are added.
options.footnote: 53: applicable to scope 1 and 2 only; scope 3 cannot be estimated by this option. 204: process emissions are added before multiplying by the attribution factor.

options.when: Outstanding amount in the company and EVIC or total debt and equity are known. Reported company emissions are not known. Emissions are calculated using primary physical activity data of the company's production and emission factors specific to that primary data.
Outstanding amount in the company, EVIC or total debt and equity, and the company's revenue are known. Emission factors for the sector per unit of revenue are known.
options.footnote: 55: where revenue is not a suitable indicator, another financial indicator may be used with the reasoning made transparent; the score is not affected.

options.when: Outstanding amount in the company is known. Emission factors for the sector per unit of asset are known.
options.footnote: 41: the attribution factor cannot be calculated; a rough estimation is made from the outstanding amount and sector-average data.

options.when: Outstanding amount in the company is known. Emission factors for the sector per unit of revenue and asset turnover ratios for the sector are known.
options.footnote: 41: the attribution factor cannot be calculated; a rough estimation is made from the outstanding amount and sector-average data.

options.when: None of the specified options is applicable. Permitted only with an explanation from the reporting institution (p.48).
options.footnote: p.48: any deviation from the specified options shall be accompanied by an explanation.
